heading: What I'm building now
lead: At Particle41 I lead backend architecture for multi-tenant SaaS products and build AI-assisted developer tooling alongside it.

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS backends
items.body: Leading backend architecture and delivery for HOA Management and Restaurant Management product work. Directing a team of up to seven and setting the clean architecture and test coverage standards that hold as the team grows.

items.title: AI-Assisted Developer Tooling
items.body: Building developer tooling and engineering workflow automation that help teams reason about requirements, implementation paths, and delivery quality. The hard parts are orchestration, practical evaluation, and knowing which parts of the software lifecycle genuinely benefit from model-assisted delegation.
